Maya R: Quick heads-up — we found a routing edge where tiered routing sends requests to a variant that doesn't support tool-calls and has truncated tokenizer behavior. We should decide failsafe behavior.
Sam P: Can you paste a minimal compatibility audit? I want to see columns: region, tier, variant_id, tokenizer_family, max_ctx, toolcall_support, kv_compat.
Maya R: Sure, quick dump below.
Maya R: ```csv
region,tier,variant,tokenizer,max_ctx,toolcall,kv
us-west,p1,v1,redwood-bpe,8192,yes,yes
us-west,p1,v2,byte-level,4096,no,yes
eu-central,enterprise,v1,redwood-bpe,16384,yes,yes
ap-south,premium,v3,byte-level,8192,partial,partial
```
Oliver K: For routing policies, prefer same-tokenizer + >= request.ctx. If tokenizer mismatch, fallback only if toolcall parity==yes or user tier is premium/enterprise? (we need rule)
Nisha S: Telemetry note: emit `routing.fallback_reason` with tags: variant_from, variant_to, reason(tokenizer|ctx|toolcall|kv). Also log `routing.fallback_latency_penalty_ms` when applied.
Liam T: Console UX: show a yellow banner when a user's requests are routed to a degraded variant: "Routed to variant v2 — tool-calls may be unavailable." Link to a quick explainer and an override button for admins.
Sam P: What about quotas/SLA? If we downgrade to lower ctx, we should check token billing. Maybe mark quota_used differently when KV partial.
Maya R: Proposed temporary rule:
Maya R: ```json
{"rule":"tiered_failsafe","condition":"tokenizer_mismatch || requested_ctx>variant_ctx || toolcall_missing","action":"route_to_best_variant_if_toolcall_ok_else_block_or_warn","admin_override":true}
```
Nisha S: Also add an eval metric: `toolcall_regression_rate` compared against baseline prompts. Need a quick automated test harness per variant.
Oliver K: Ops ask — can we add a CI gate that prevents routing table deploy if any variant has `toolcall` field set to `no` while it's advertised as supported in model catalog?
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: routing-table-v12 -> staging (started) :rocket:
Liam T: Quick implementation plan: 1) Audit + CSV -> DONE 2) Telemetry event + tests -> 3d 3) Console banner + admin override -> 2d 4) Routing rule enforcement + CI gate -> 4d
Maya R: I'll file the RFC and add the CSV to the doc. @Sam P @Nisha S please review the telemetry schema before I flip the flag.
Sam P: Ack. Will review today.
Nisha S: Ack, ping me when the event names are in the schema. I'll hook the alerts.
Maya R: Thanks — will follow up with PR.
